disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder (clinical cohort) analyzed with normative modeling across lifespan.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is an early-onset neurodevelopmental disorder"; "we characterize the distinct developmental patterns of cortical morphology in individuals with ASD"
disorder-name.location: Wang2023.pdf.md: ABSTRACT / opening paragraph; Wang2023.pdf.md: ABSTRACT / opening paragraph

dataset-of-origin.detail: Clinical cohort pooled from three datasets.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "All data are acquired from ABIDE-I [40], ABIDE-II [41] and KQJH."

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD across ASD cohorts after QA (ABIDE I N=393, ABIDE II N=402, KQJH N=216); min/max from reported ASD ranges.
age.supporting_text: "After the QA steps described above, ABIDE I consisted of 393 ASD participants (N=58 female), age range 7-64 (M = 12.72, SD = 6.38)"; "ABIDE II consisted of 402 ASD participants (N=54 female), age range 7-64 (M = 17.04, SD = 7.95)"; "KQJH consisted of 216 ASD participants (N=38 female), age range 1-6 (M = 2.65, SD = 0.83)"

sex.detail: Female counts summed across ASD cohorts; male counts inferred by subtracting female from total N.
sex.supporting_text: "After the QA steps described above, ABIDE I consisted of 393 ASD participants (N=58 female)"; "ABIDE II consisted of 402 ASD participants (N=54 female)"; "KQJH consisted of 216 ASD participants (N=38 female)"
